page_title: BRE 0-0 LYO | Brest v Lyon 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Clement Turpin has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+8' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
90+6' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dominik Greif intercepts the ball.
90+6' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+5' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) tries to find Pavel Sulc, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
90+5' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+2' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Hugo Magnetti (Brest) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
90+1' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Radoslaw Majecki (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.

90+1' Tyler Morton (Lyon) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Radoslaw Majecki to dive and make a save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lyon have a free kick.
89' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
88' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
87' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
87' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kenny Lala (Brest). Brest force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
85' Neat link-up play between Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) and Ludovic Ajorque, but Dominik Greif reads the game well and the move breaks down.
85' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
84' Corentin Tolisso just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) replaces him.
83' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

82' Nice individual effort by Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Dominik Greif does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
82' Substitution. Pathe Mboup makes his way off the pitch and Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
80' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
79' 8:1 – the corner kicks stats.
78' Kenny Lala (Brest) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) is coming onto the pitch as Martin Satriano cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
75' Clinton Mata (Lyon) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
74' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) flies well wide of the right post.
74' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) steps up to send the ball in.
73' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a throw-in.
72' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) replaces Mama Balde.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Tousart departs the field of play to be replaced by Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
71' Pathe Mboup (Brest) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
70' Martin Satriano (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
70' A pass by Radoslaw Majecki (Brest) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Lyon will take a throw-in.
68' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
67' Looks like Clinton Mata (Lyon) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
65' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Clement Turpin signals a set piece.
64' Tyler Morton (Lyon) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
63' The free kick is delivered by Tyler Morton (Lyon) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pathe Mboup (Brest) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Brendan Chardonnet (Brest).
61' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
61' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
60' Lucas Tousart (Brest) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brest are going to take it.
58' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Pathe Mboup (Brest) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
58' The resulting corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared by the defence.
57' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
55' Dominik Greif leaps to intercept the corner kick from Romain Del Castillo (Brest).

54' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
51' The players claim that Mama Balde (Brest) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
51' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
51' Pathe Mboup (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Brest have a corner.
49' A corner kick by Brest is thwarted by the well prepared Dominik Greif (Lyon).
49' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) tries to find Dominik Greif, but he puts too much power on the pass.
49' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up an injury.
47' Mama Balde (Brest) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
47' Some great controlled play and passing from Brest. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Referee Clement Turpin sees the trip by Pathe Mboup (Brest) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Afonso Moreira received a clever long ball from Tyler Morton (Lyon) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
44' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 43:57.
41' Lucas Tousart (Brest) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.

39' Bradley Locko (Brest) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
37' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Pathe Mboup (Brest) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Lyon players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
34' Lucas Tousart (Brest) trips an opposition player and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
32' Joris Chotard (Brest) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
30' Martin Satriano (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) was too aggressive in his challenge.
28' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

27' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Dominik Greif shows his agility and makes a save. Dominik Greif pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pathe Mboup (Brest) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the left post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
27' Tyler Morton (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Radoslaw Majecki comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
26' Mama Balde (Brest) tries to find Ludovic Ajorque, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
24' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
22' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Tyler Morton (Lyon) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
21' A pass into the penalty area from Pathe Mboup (Brest) is intercepted by the defence.
19' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

18' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
17' Kenny Lala (Brest) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ludovic Ajorque, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
15' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) comes onto the pitch so that Tanner Tessmann can be given a rest.
14' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Brest.
13' The Lyon players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
10' A cross from the by-line finds Mama Balde (Brest) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
9' Mama Balde (Brest) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
8' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Hans Hateboer (Lyon). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

7' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Hans Hateboer (Lyon), but referee Clement Turpin must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
7' Hans Hateboer (Lyon) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' The ball is cleared after Martin Satriano (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lyon will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Clement Turpin.
